plan: An undead colossus who charges across the map and briefly comes back to life after dying.
aSurveiller: His Q (Decimating Smash). Charged for long, it knocks up: get out of the zone before he strikes.
contrer: Get out of the zone of his Q before he strikes.
After he dies, move away: he briefly comes back to life.
Step out of his charge (R): it crosses the map.
forces: Engages from far with his R.
faiblesses: His spells are easy to see coming.

sorts.P: Briefly comes back to life after dying.
sorts.E: Shockwave that slows and reduces armour.

momentFort: Solid from the start of the game. He shines mostly in the mid game: in the late game, many champions outscale him.
